svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-01
svg.desc: Projectile homing and graph-facing snapshot refresh.
svg.text: 2026-08-01 - Projectile homing and snapshot refresh
main | 3 commits: 3e62fc6, a1762bd, b5e8c87
Daily job
Finish projectile behavior and synchronize graph-facing generated assets.
Projectile collision/homing/tests, PlayMontage data ownership, and broad Blueprint snapshots changed.
BEFORE
Projectile and graph state split
Collision/homing behavior needed fixes.
Montage data could be hidden in ability setup.
Snapshots did not mirror the latest assets.
Runtime and graph review surfaces diverged.
AFTER
Projectile behavior and snapshots align
Projectile collision, homing support, and tests are updated.
PlayMontage owns montage data in the graph node definition.
Blueprint snapshots refresh AI, abilities, effects, actors, UI, and controllers.
The snapshot set mirrors the post-migration content state.
Guard: runtime actor behavior and graph-node data remain distinct review surfaces.
Important guard
Read projectile code for collision/homing.
Read PlayMontage definition for timing/data.
Treat snapshots as the asset review mirror.
Validation / newcomer path
Compare projectile runtime, graph node definition,
and refreshed snapshots in that order.
The August map has the full asset surface.
